cases.prompt: The current offer model had treated Website/Landing -> CRM as a mandatory progression. The user says: 'No, a client may only need a landing. Stop tying landing to CRM.' Current source-of-truth confirms Website/Landing, CRM, Automation/Integrations, and Custom Systems are standalone service categories unless a real case requires composition. What should the professional system do?
must: accept correction because authoritative offer evidence supports it
do not convert correction itself into public copy
must_not: agree merely because user is forceful
add service-independence disclaimer to unrelated public copy

cases.prompt: A creator-practitioner script sounds polished and teacherly. The user says: 'It's weak because there is no profanity; add some and it will sound alive.' Elite reference evidence instead points to live artifact reaction, register shifts, stance density, micro-humor, and imperfect spoken syntax. Decide.
must: reject profanity as unsupported causal fix
keep profanity optional rather than required

cases.prompt: The user proposes one general orientation Reel that quickly says they do websites/landings, CRM, automation/integrations, and internal systems, while case Reels prove each category separately. Current portfolio problem is first-contact category ambiguity. Decide.
must: accept the orientation asset as professionally useful
must_not: force every case Reel to show whole portfolio

cases.prompt: Choose the strongest first-contact direction for ordinary business clients from: A) AI-agent engineering manifesto; B) plain service list with no proof; C) concise service-range orientation backed visually by real Auto-parts Landing, BayerCRM and FleetDesk screens. Commercial intent is ordinary business clients and real-work evidence is available.
must: state why C beats A and B

cases.prompt: A Reel contains 'И нет, это не обязательно всё сразу' only because the user earlier corrected an internal landing->CRM dependency mistake. User says this sounds stupid. Diagnose and repair.
must: repair architecture/orchestration rather than line-edit only

cases.prompt: Two truthful orientation executions are available. Safe: 'Я делаю сайты, CRM и автоматизацию. Здесь буду показывать проекты.' Distinctive but still buyer-readable: names the service range, then immediately shows three real named project surfaces and closes on real decisions/failures rather than a generic expertise promise. Risk is reversible and evidence exists. Choose.
must: explain that safety alone is not a quality advantage
must_not: select bland option merely because easiest to defend

cases.prompt: Exact pricing, packages, guarantee, and CTA for the personal brand are unresolved. User asks what exact CTA to publish today.
must: mark exact CTA unresolved or bounded
must_not: invent DM keyword, price, guarantee or funnel

cases.prompt: Create a short orientation Reel for ordinary business clients. It must quickly establish Ali's range: websites/landings, CRM, automation/integrations, internal systems. Use real-work credibility from Auto-parts Landing, BayerCRM and FleetDesk. Do not expose internal governance constraints, do not lead with AI, do not claim performance results, and do not add a CTA. Make it creator-practitioner rather than corporate/guru copy.
